## Summary
Encounter is a new resource type: the glossary, the schema and all four layers change. Keep it FHIR-lite (not conformant, per ADR-0001) and make the Observation link optional.

## Findings
| id | severity | category | location | evidence | recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ARC-001 | medium | domain | context/domain/fhir-lite-glossary.md:7 | The glossary defines only four resource types; Encounter changes the domain contract | Add Encounter (fields, PHI classification) to the glossary before code. |
| ARC-002 | medium | data | sample-app/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__init.sql:16 | observation has no encounter column | `V2__encounter.sql`: `encounter` table plus nullable `observation.encounter_id` FK (encounter reference optional, so existing Observations stay valid). |
| ARC-003 | low | design | context/standards/coding-standards.md:3 | Coding-standards rule 1 layering | EncounterController -> EncounterService -> EncounterRepository, with an `EncounterResource` record at the edge. |

## Decisions
- Draft ADR-0002 "Add Encounter as a FHIR-lite resource"; the app stays a FHIR-lite, non-conformant server as ADR-0001 decided.
